latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of agent-constitution-guard, providing enforceable constitutional guardrails for AI agents.
- Define immutable behavioral rules, permission boundaries, escalation policies, and safety interlocks to prevent agents from exceeding authorized scope.
- Introduces a multi-layered architecture: Immutable Checks, Policy Engine, Escalation, and Audit Log.
- Includes CLI and code usage examples for rule creation, action checks, escalation handling, and audit log review.
- Provides real-world examples for production data protection, cost control, and data privacy compliance.
- Ready-to-integrate with middleware and OpenClaw skill wrapper patterns.
